info.name: Kindergarten tour
info.description: A walk around a whole kindergarten, as each role. First fill an empty database: `npm run dev`, then `npm run seed` in another terminal (15 groups, 190 kids, staff, discounts, a published timetable). Then run "Start here" and any folder. Nothing here creates data, except a note of the parent.

item.name: Start here: log in
item.description: One token for each role; the folders below use their own. Accounts come from npm run seed; the password of each is <username>-password.

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', (() => { const body = pm.response.json(); return body.token; })());
if (pm.response.code < 300) pm.collectionVariables.set('managerToken', (() => { const body = pm.response.json(); return body.token; })());
if (pm.response.code < 300) pm.collectionVariables.set('educatorToken', (() => { const body = pm.response.json(); return body.token; })());
if (pm.response.code < 300) pm.collectionVariables.set('parentToken', (() => { const body = pm.response.json(); return body.token; })());
if (pm.response.code < 300) pm.collectionVariables.set('teacherToken', (() => { const body = pm.response.json(); return body.token; })());

item.name: Admin
item.description: The owner ("дід"): money, the whole kindergarten, the accounts.

exec: pm.test("15 groups", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.groups.length).to.eql(15); });
pm.test("shared expenses as the BA: 570 000", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.shared.total).to.eql(570000); });
pm.test("in the black", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total.profit).to.be.above(0); });

request.description: Income, expenses and profit of each of the 15 groups and of the kindergarten (FR-017).

item.name: Forecast: these kids, planned for the most profit

exec: pm.test("a forecast and now to compare", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Object.keys(body)).to.include("now"); });

request.description: The kids of the seed by age. Compare total with fewestGroups and with now.

exec: pm.test("too many groups", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.error.code).to.eql("TOO_MANY_GROUPS"); });

request.description: 4 ages × 75 kids need 4 groups each: 16 groups, more than the 15 allowed (BR-19).

exec: pm.test("15 groups", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.groups.length).to.eql(15); });
pm.test("no problems", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.problems).to.eql([]); });

request.description: Records that break the rules of the kindergarten (FR-019): none after the seed.

exec: pm.test("the admin and four roles", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(5); });
pm.test("published, with every event", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect([body.status, body.entries.length > 0]).to.eql(['PUBLISHED', true]); });

request.description: The timetable in force with every event; no id needed.

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) pm.collectionVariables.set('otherGroupId', (() => { const body = pm.response.json(); return body.items[body.items.length - 1].id; })());

item.name: Manager
item.description: Runs the kindergarten day to day; reads the money, does not change it.

exec: pm.test("38 kids of 5", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(38); });
if (pm.response.code < 300) pm.collectionVariables.set('otherKidId', (() => { const body = pm.response.json(); return body.items[0].id; })());
if (pm.response.code < 300) pm.collectionVariables.set('discountKidId', (() => { const body = pm.response.json(); return body.items[0].id; })());

Register a manager: only the admin (BR-65)
Educator
item.description: Sees their own group, its kids with their parents and its timetable (2.3).

exec: pm.test("one group", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(1); });
if (pm.response.code < 300) pm.collectionVariables.set('groupId', (() => { const body = pm.response.json(); return body.items[0].id; })());
pm.test("13 kids", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(13); });
pm.test("breakfast at 09:00 on Monday", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.days.MON[0].start).to.eql("09:00"); });

item.name: Parent
item.description: Sees their own kids, what they cost, their group and timetable (2.6).

exec: pm.test("two kids", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(2); });
if (pm.response.code < 300) pm.collectionVariables.set('kidId', (() => { const body = pm.response.json(); return body.items[0].id; })());
if (pm.response.code < 300) pm.collectionVariables.set('kidGroupId', (() => { const body = pm.response.json(); return body.items[0].groupId; })());
pm.test("tuition, meals and the total", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.totalPerMonth).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: The group of my kid: names only

exec: pm.test("id and names", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Object.keys(body.items[0]).sort()).to.eql(["firstName", "id", "lastName"]); });

item.name: Timetable of the group of my kid
Teacher
item.description: Sees their timetable and the groups they teach, with the name, sex and age of the kids (2.4).

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) pm.collectionVariables.set('teacherId', (() => { const body = pm.response.json(); return body.teacherId; })());
pm.test("lessons of music", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Object.values(body.days).flat().every((e) => e.subject.name === "Music")).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Kids of a group: name, sex, age

exec: pm.test("no more than that", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Object.keys(body.items[0]).sort()).to.eql(["age", "firstName", "id", "lastName", "sex"]); });
